what: Web build of this branch (f7258fe0) served on 8062, opened in the Claude desktop app's built-in browser (Chromium). Hooks on AudioBufferSourceNode.prototype.start and MessagePort.prototype.postMessage (the no-threads stream worklet) were installed before the first input; one click on the title background unlocked audio, then Down and Up on the title menu.
playback_mode: Godot web sample playback: every sound is an AudioBufferSourceNode; the stream worklet only received silent chunks (5,943 chunks, all zero).

before_fix_build.console: ERROR: Parent node is busy setting up children, `add_child()` failed.
before_fix_build.after_click_and_keys: 0 buffer sources started, worklet chunks all zero: silent

loop_restart_gap_ms.note: Godot's web samples loop by starting the buffer again on its 'ended' event, so each wrap leaves about 3-25 ms of silence (audio clock 10.7 ms, resolution 2.7 ms). Desktop wraps sample-exactly (decode-check.json, capture-check.json).
